summary:
Disputed by the supplier: GnuTLS does not check an excluded msUPN/SRV
otherName name constraint. The CVE record notes that GnuTLS does not
consider this an actionable vulnerability, because its threat model excludes
attacks that need control of material inside the trust boundary (trusted CAs
and the certificates they issue). There is no upstream fix; Debian rates it
unimportant and leaves it unfixed in every suite.
